card.name: Linking words in tuberculosis drug resistance
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, to, of, with, least) right before a drug name or the word drug in tuberculosis text, especially about resistance to isoniazid and rifampin or multi-drug regimens.

modes.label: Between TB drug names
modes.description: The word 'and' or 'to' sitting between or before first-line TB drugs in resistance statements.
modes.example: Because of the impact of resistance to isoniazid<< and>> rifampin on the response to therapy

modes.label: Before regimen or drug resistance
modes.description: Linking words before 'drug' or a list of drugs in TB treatment regimens.
modes.example: When streptomycin is added to this regimen because of suspected or<< proven>> drug resistance

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word drug, multi-drug, or anti- terms next.
card.plain: It lights up on small linking words in tuberculosis text just before a drug name or the phrase drug resistance is expected.
